subject: Request: Novum Health permission for customer reference & logo
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@novumhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com
Cc: Elena Petrova <elena@novumhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Customer reference request — short quote + logo use

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Redwood integration has cut inference cost and latency for three of our critical workflows, and the team has been pleased. Marketing at Novum would like to include a short quote and our logo on a one-page Redwood case summary and on the website product page.

Quick asks:
- Permission to publish the Novum Health logo (web and social) and a 1–2 line quote attributed to Novum Health (Elena is the comms lead cc'd).
- Confirmation you can send the exact quote text and the logo artwork you expect us to use.
- Any legal delighters (signature or specific wording) you need.

If you want, Elena and I can run this through Novum legal quickly — otherwise we can sign a simple permission form.

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Sr. Engineering Manager, Data & ML
Novum Health

Attachments: none

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com <karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com>

Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.example.com
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 17:05:00 +00:00
Subject: Fwd: Customer reference request — short quote + logo use

Laura / Marissa — forwarding Novum's request. They want permission to publish a 1–2 line quote + logo. Novum is an important expansion account (DEAL-2026-1173).

Marissa: can your team draft a suggested short quote and provide the redwood-approved logo variants?
Laura: any legal constraints we should surface (attribution, trademark text, color usage, do-not-alter rules)? Novum mentioned legal may want to review — I'd like us to be proactive and send the exact assets and a simple permission form rather than back-and-forth redlines.

Plan I propose:
1) Marissa drafts the quote and picks logo files (web/social/PNG/SVG)
2) Laura confirms legal language and attaches a one-page permission form for them to sign
3) I send to Sanjay + Elena with assets and DocuSign link

Please see quick context: Novum needs this for a partner press summary they are preparing. Timeline: they'd like sign-off within a week if possible.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment suggested by me: redwood-brand-badge-vertical.png (will attach once Marissa confirms)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.example.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.example.com
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Customer reference request — short quote + logo use

Karthik —

Thanks for the heads-up. Reviewed Novum's ask and the proposed process. We can approve publication with the following conditions (standard practice):

1) Quote attribution: must be limited to the final approved wording — Novum must sign to confirm the exact quote text.
2) Logo usage: provide Novum with the approved logos only (full color and monochrome). They may not alter colors, proportions, or add marks. If they need a different file type for editorial, we provide it on request.
3) Trademark notice: include a line: “Novum Health is a registered trademark of Novum Health, used with permission.”
4) No confidential product details in the quote (they already avoided this in the draft).
5) Permission form: I attached a short one-page "Marketing Use Permission" that covers the points above. We need one signature from an authorized Novum signatory.

Marissa — I reviewed the draft quote you circulated offline ("Redwood reduced our inference costs by 40% and improved end-to-end latency by 2x"), which is fine but I'd prefer it softened slightly to avoid numeric specificity without an internal Novum verification. Suggest: "Redwood significantly reduced our inference costs and improved model latency, enabling faster product iteration."

Naomi — FYI for comms review; if you want to tweak tone, please do.

I'll approve the permission form once Novum signs and we confirm the final quote text and the logo file variants.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Novum_Marketing_Permission_Form_2026.pdf
